{{Quote|Ultimately, the Rakata wanted the secrets of the Infinity Gate technology. We refused to give it to them, so they made war on us, their benefactors. We did not give it to them.|A'nang|<ref name="DOTJ 4" />}}
Many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[36,453 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] '''made war''' upon their [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] benefactors, who had taught the Rakata how to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], when the Kwa refused to give the Rakata their [[Infinity Gate]] technology. Using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and the technology that the Kwa gave them, the Rakata forged an [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] based on conquest and [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of Force-rich worlds, and they sought to use Infinity Gate technology to travel instantaneously between worlds. The Kwa fought back against the Rakata on the Rakata [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]], holding the Rakata off until several of their number could destroy the Infinity Gate on Lehon, though many Kwa died in the process. Following the battle, the Kwa destroyed or disabled most of the remaining gates across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and retreated to their homeworld of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], though some Kwa like [[A'nang]] remained behind on worlds such as [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="DOTJ 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle between the Kwa and Rakata was first shown through a flashback in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 4]],<ref name="DOTJ 4" /> which was released on [[March 27]], [[2013]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/19-806/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-The-Prisoner-of-Bogan-4|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi—The Prisoner of Bogan #4}}</ref>
